sources.name: National Scholarship Portal
sources.notes: Main national portal for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric central sector and state schemes. Application windows fluctuate annually.

sources.name: Skill India Digital Hub
sources.notes: Under MSDE; provides PMKVY, short-term courses, and apprenticeship opportunities.

sources.name: Bharat Skills
sources.notes: DGT repository for Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS), Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS), and blended courses.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India
sources.notes: Catalogues historical disbursements and scheme summaries; requires API key for automated REST endpoints.

sources.name: Department of School Education & Literacy (MoE)
sources.notes: Hosts official guidelines for National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) and Samagra Shiksha.

sources.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sources.notes: Official policy guidelines for PM-YASASVI, Pre-Matric SC, Post-Matric SC, Top Class Education.

sources.name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
sources.notes: Official scheme guidelines for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric scholarships for Scheduled Tribe students.
